Title: Mark Single Attendance - Present Day Valid Input
Description: Verify marking attendance as present for a valid employee on a specific date.
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID 1 exists in the system.
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body {"employeeId":1,"absent":false,"date":"2025-01-01"}.
Verify response status is 200 OK.
Verify response body contains attendance record with employeeId=1, absent=false, date=2025-01-01.
Expected Result: Attendance is marked as present for employee 1 on 2025-01-01 and returned in response.

Title: Mark Single Attendance - Absent Day Valid Input
Description: Verify marking attendance as absent for a valid employee on a specific date.
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID 2 exists in the system.
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body {"employeeId":2,"absent":true,"date":"2025-01-01"}.
Verify response status is 200 OK.
Verify response body contains attendance record with employeeId=2, absent=true, date=2025-01-01.
Expected Result: Attendance is marked as absent for employee 2 on 2025-01-01 and returned in response.

Title: Mark Single Attendance - Missing employeeId
Description: Verify API returns bad request when employeeId is missing in request body.
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body {"absent":false,"date":"2025-01-02"}.
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request.
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'.
Expected Result: API rejects request with 400 status and error message due to missing employeeId.

Title: Mark Single Attendance - Invalid employeeId Negative Value
Description: Verify API behavior when employeeId is invalid (negative number).
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body {"employeeId":-1,"absent":false,"date":"2025-01-03"}.
Verify response status is 200 OK or appropriate error if validation exists.
If accepted, verify attendance record is created or updated with employeeId=-1.
Expected Result: If no explicit validation, attendance is marked with employeeId -1; otherwise, error response.

Title: Mark Single Attendance - Future Date Boundary
Description: Verify marking attendance on a far future date is accepted.
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID 3 exists in the system.
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body {"employeeId":3,"absent":false,"date":"2099-12-31"}.
Verify response status is 200 OK.
Verify attendance record is created with date 2099-12-31.
Expected Result: Attendance is successfully marked for future date without errors.

Title: Mark Batch Attendance - Multiple Valid Records
Description: Verify batch marking attendance with multiple valid attendance records.
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with body containing two attendance DTOs: one present for employee 1 on 2025-01-01, one absent for employee 2 on 2025-01-01.
Verify response status is 200 OK.
Verify response body contains savedCount=2, presentCount=1, absentCount=1, invalidEntries=[].
Expected Result: Both attendance records are saved successfully with correct counts and no invalid entries.

Title: Mark Batch Attendance - Empty Payload
Description: Verify API returns bad request when batch payload is empty.
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty array body [].
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request.
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'.
Expected Result: API rejects empty batch payload with 400 status and error message.

Title: Mark Batch Attendance - Payload with Invalid Entries
Description: Verify batch marking attendance with some invalid entries (missing employeeId or absent).
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with body containing one valid record (employeeId=1, absent=false, date=2025-01-01) and one invalid record (employeeId=null, absent=true).
Verify response status is 200 OK.
Verify response body contains savedCount=1, presentCount=1, absentCount=0, invalidEntries containing null or missing employeeId entries.
Expected Result: Valid records are saved; invalid entries are reported in invalidEntries list.

Title: Mark Batch Attendance - Payload with Invalid employeeId
Description: Verify batch marking attendance with invalid employeeId values are handled correctly.
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with body containing one record with employeeId=-1, absent=false, date=2025-01-03.
Verify response status is 200 OK or error if validation exists.
If accepted, verify attendance record is saved; if rejected, verify error message.
Expected Result: If no validation, attendance saved; otherwise, error response returned.

Title: Mark Batch Attendance - Future Date Boundary
Description: Verify batch marking attendance with a future date boundary value.
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with body containing one record with employeeId=3, absent=false, date=2099-12-31.
Verify response status is 200 OK.
Verify attendance record is saved with date 2099-12-31.
Expected Result: Attendance is successfully marked for future date in batch without errors.

Title: Get all employees successfully
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe returns a list of all employees with HTTP 200 status
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe
Verify the response status is 200 OK
Verify the response body is a JSON array
Verify each element in the array contains employee details
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with a JSON array of employees

Title: Get single employee by valid ID
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns the employee details when a valid existing ID is provided
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/1
Verify the response status is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains employee details with ID 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with employee details for ID 1

Title: Get single employee with non-existing ID
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns 404 when the employee ID does not exist
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/9999
Verify the response status is 404 Not Found
Verify the response body contains message 'employee not found'
Expected Result: Response status 404 with message 'employee not found'

Title: Get single employee with null ID
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns 400 Bad Request when ID is null
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/null (or omit ID)
Verify the response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify the response body contains message 'id is required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'id is required'

Title: Create employee with valid data
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee creates a new employee when valid name and role are provided
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"name": "Aman Gupt", "role": "Developer", "absent": false}
Verify the response status is 201 Created
Verify the Location header contains URI of the created employee
Verify the response body contains the created employee details including generated ID
Expected Result: Response status 201 Created with Location header and created employee details

Title: Create employee with missing name and role
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee returns 400 Bad Request when name and role are missing or empty
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"name": "", "role": "", "absent": ""}
Verify the response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify the response body contains message 'name and role are required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'name and role are required'

Title: Create employee with missing name
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee returns 400 Bad Request when name is missing but role is provided

Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'name and role are required'

Title: Create employee with missing role

Verify the response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify the response body contains message 'name and role are required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'name and role are required'

Expected Result: Response status 204 No Content and employee deleted

Title: Create employee with boundary long name
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee accepts a long name at boundary length and creates employee successfully
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"name": "VeryLongNameVeryLongNameVeryLongName", "role": "Senior Engineer", "absent": false}
Verify the response status is 201 Created
Verify the response body contains the created employee with the long name
Expected Result: Response status 201 Created with employee created with long name

Title: Create employee with negative ID in body (ignored)
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee ignores ID in request body and creates employee with new ID
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"id": -1, "name": "John Doe", "role": "Manager", "absent": false}
Verify the response status is 201 Created
Verify the response body contains employee details with a generated positive ID, not -1
Expected Result: Response status 201 Created with new generated ID ignoring -1
